Senses.Explanation: The time-span: what the teacher points at is fixed from the deepest past to this breath, while everything that moves, moves across it. Baichi Xingyuan pins the open scenery at an offering hall as reaching everywhere and spanning all time without a hair's shift; Hanyue Fazang tells his assembly that whoever gets that line holds sky and earth by the hand, born before heaven and earth and never aging, and the whole span is only oneself; Dadian Baotong, in the old case Jifei Ruyi raises, lifts his beads at the exiled official's puzzle and answers with the hundred-and-eight count that runs day and night through all time; Ruibai Mingxue folds the whole coming-and-going of the teaching story into one thought that spans all time with no ordinary and no sage. Yinyuan Longqi at the fifth-month gathering lets the whole of it show the moment the season arrives; Yun'e Xi rides the span on the everywhere-master line, coming and going like a thing surfacing and sinking; Lianfeng Su closes his hall address on the moon that neither rounds nor wanes and lights the world through all time; and Yunwai Xingze warns the assembly that even so, the span-member still leaves room for the true and the false.
